# Paseo fixtures (E3)

**DRAFT-documented-shape.** Every value in this folder is invented. The shapes come from the documentation and the installed `@getpaseo/client` 0.15.3 types.

Nothing here is a real prompt, title, folder, session or credential. `SENTINEL_*` strings stand where real text would be, so `test/experiments/sentinel.test.ts` can prove the script never prints or records them.

| File                              | Shape comes from                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Used for                                                                                                     |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `daemon-ok.json`                  | TECH › Feasibility experiments (E3) and `docs/tech/data-and-sources.md` › Paseo enrichment: an `agents.list` result is `entries: [{ agent, project }]` (SDK type `PaseoAgentListResult`); `agent` carries `id`, `provider`, `workspaceId`, `labels` (a delegated agent has `paseo.parent-agent-id`), `runtimeInfo.sessionId`, `archivedAt`; `project.workspaceName` is the workspace label | Everything matches: session ids on disk, a parent edge, workspace labels, archived listing                   |
| `daemon-mismatch.json`            | same                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Session ids not on disk, a parent that is not listed, no workspace labels, archived listing refused          |
| `daemon-password.json`            | R10 (no password by default) and the SDK's `DaemonAuthenticationError`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | A daemon that asks for a password                                                                            |
| `daemon-down.json`                | `docs/tech/data-and-sources.md` › Discovery (`notrunning`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | No daemon listening                                                                                          |
| `disk/codex/**`, `disk/claude/**` | R1 (Codex rollouts are named `rollout-<time>-<thread id>.jsonl`) and R3 (Claude transcripts are `projects/<project>/<session>.jsonl`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | File names only: E3 never opens these files, so their one line each is only a stand-in that holds a sentinel |

The top level of each `daemon-*.json` is not the SDK's: `connect` (`ok`, `refused` or `password`) and `archivedListing` (`supported` or `unsupported`) tell the fake client what to do, and `agents` / `archived` hold SDK-shaped entries.
